user.title: emoose X300
user.description: Enter the MQTT topic prefix your station publishes under. If its traffic is redirected to your own broker unchanged, this is "$oc/devices/<device id>" (the device id is in the station's report topic). If you bridge it into a local broker under a different name, use that prefix instead.

error.invalid_prefix: Enter a topic prefix without the wildcards + or #.

abort.already_configured: This topic prefix is already set up.
abort.mqtt_required: The MQTT integration is not set up or not connected. Set it up first.
